mechanism: Both fish oil and dronedarone have antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties, and dronedarone has Class III antiarrhythmic effects that may be potentiated by omega-3 fatty acids, increasing bleeding risk and QT prolongation potential.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and cardiac arrhythmias; consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; counsel patient on bleeding precautions and report unusual bruising or bleeding.
